lead: The sources an AI reply cites: a small pill (icon + title) that opens in a new tab; with a description, hovering shows a preview card. Document sources are not links, and a pile of sources can be folded into a "3 sources" group.

preview.title: Hover preview
preview.description: Give a `description` and hovering or focusing the pill with the keyboard shows a preview card.

api.title: API Reference
api.marker: The citation marker in the body text (a small numbered badge): `index` is its number, the rest is the same as Citation; its name is "Source n: title". Markdown's `citations` use it, and it can be used on its own.
api.citations: Folds sources into one group: the trigger reads "3 sources" and expands to a row of Citations. Closed by default; the open state works like Base UI's Collapsible.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.icon: The round icon slot, the site icon and the initial-letter fallback
styling.title: The title (truncated when too long)
styling.preview: The content of the preview card (the card's shell borrows Popover's slots)
styling.marker: The citation marker in the body text (`a` / `span`)
styling.citations: Root of a group of sources
styling.trigger: The trigger and its expand arrow; `data-panel-open`
styling.panel: The expanded panel and the wrapping list of sources in it
